scope: Primary papers, author repositories and versioned official tool documentation. No model calls, credential reads, source edits or baseline edits.
interpretation: These sources motivate hypotheses and safeguards. None evaluates this GPT-6 Luna three-role FHIR team or demonstrates that the proposed local fixes improve its accuracy. The original FHIR-AgentBench single-agent architecture and inherited per-call context policy must be distinguished from the new local team.

pilot_constraints.context_policy: Retain inherited 32k fairness policy in the main repair pilot. Any larger-context study must be a separate controlled comparison across all systems.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.findings: On the sampled GPT-4 GSM8K evaluation, standard prompting scored 95.5%, then intrinsic correction scored 91.5% and 89.0% after one/two rounds. Oracle stopping achieved 97.5%. GPT-4 used 200 sampled questions, not the full test set. Equal-response comparisons also expose extra-compute confounding.
sources.local_inference: Retain external source/execution gates, measure right-to-wrong losses, and compare methods at fixed budgets. A second model opinion or apparent agreement is not a correctness certificate.
sources.limits: Historical models and math/commonsense/closed-book QA; no FHIR or Luna evidence. Oracle feedback is unavailable in deployment.
sources.must_test: On fixed development cases, retain failures and measure both correction gains and losses; distinguish semantic errors from operational withholding.

sources.title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
sources.read_sections: Method; Table 2; execution-feedback ablation; Appendix E.2 failure examples; author README.
sources.findings: For mathematical program synthesis, GPT-3.5-Turbo GSM8K rose from PoT 72.5% to CRITIC 78.2%; the no-tool variant scored 77.0%. Improvement is not universal: Text-Davinci-003 SVAMP fell from 84.0% to 80.7%. The paper documents wrong verification and wrong correction despite execution feedback.
sources.local_inference: Use actual execution outputs and structured error feedback for bounded repair. Keep semantic/scope checks: successful execution does not establish a correct question interpretation.
sources.limits: Web QA, math programs and toxicity tasks; oracle variants must not be conflated with deployed correction. No diagnostic/final schema ablation or FHIR team evaluation.
sources.must_test: Inspection objects cannot count as final computation; a final scalar/result list must agree with the verdict; preserve source and budget gates.

sources.title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
sources.findings: Factored verification answers questions without conditioning on the initial response. For Llama 65B biographies, FACTSCORE was 60.8 joint, 63.7 factored and 71.4 factor+revise, versus 55.9 few-shot. Generated fact count also fell: 16.6 few-shot versus 12.3 factor+revise.
sources.local_inference: Consider a blind independent-computation-first development ablation before exposing the candidate answer. Compare retained correct content/coverage as well as final accuracy.
sources.limits: List QA, closed-book MultiSpanQA and biographies with historical Llama models. Independence reduces conditioning, but does not prove source validity, completeness or clinical semantics.
sources.must_test: Under unchanged budgets, measure wrong-draft clear verdicts, false withholding, citation coverage and supported-empty outcomes; do not presume three agents outperform one.

sources.title: tau-bench: A Benchmark for Tool-Agent-User Interaction in Real-World Domains
sources.read_sections: Task construction/evaluation; pass^k definition; Table 2 and consistency discussion; current author README.
sources.findings: The original benchmark checks final database state against annotated goals. GPT-4o function calling scored 61.2% retail, 35.2% airline and 48.2% domain-average. Retail pass^8 was below 25%. Pass^k measures all k trials succeeding, unlike pass@k. The current original repository warns that its tasks are outdated.
sources.local_inference: Validate complete end-to-end contracts and domain rules, not only parsable tool calls or model self-reports; retain repeated-run reliability and versioned provenance.
sources.limits: Transactional customer service and simulated users, not read-only clinical QA. Numerical scores cannot predict local performance; use the pinned paper for historical claims.
sources.must_test: Repeated fixed development trials must check patient/time scope, final computation shape, release gates and artifact completeness. No benchmark migration is proposed.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol specification: Tools and structured tool results
sources.read_sections: Tool definitions; Structured Content; Output Schema; Error Handling.
sources.findings: The versioned specification separates inputSchema from optional outputSchema and identifies structuredContent as server-produced data. When outputSchema exists, servers must conform and clients should validate. This is an interface requirement, not an empirical accuracy result.
sources.local_inference: Define inspection data and final computation data explicitly, validate them at the Python/host boundary, and preserve tool error provenance. Adopting MCP itself is unnecessary.
sources.limits: Schema conformance cannot establish correct filters, patient scope, complete evidence or semantic answer validity. The local pipeline currently uses its own registry, not MCP.
sources.must_test: Objects/object lists/mixed diagnostic rows cannot become final answers accidentally; finite typed answer values and verdict agreement remain necessary; stale calculations stay invalidated.

evidence_to_local_findings.observed_contract_failure: The local audit found 19 correct-draft losses ending in diagnostic dictionaries/object lists instead of accepted final calculations. The schema separation fix is directly motivated by local traces; MCP provides a design precedent, not empirical proof of a gain.
evidence_to_local_findings.verification_limits: The local verifier cleared 25 typed-wrong initial drafts. Huang/CRITIC/CoVe motivate measuring semantic error and conditioning; none proves those exact errors would disappear.
preserved_safeguards: Actual tool result equals reported recomputation
evidence_to_local_findings.development_only: Use synthetic and existing pilot/development cases for regression and controlled ablations. Preserve the completed benchmark as an immutable measurement; no new held-out tuning or paid inference is authorized by this research task.
